statement: Fresh saltglass preserves the greatest pressure since its last kiln reset; reheating erases the earlier record.
A survey lens must face its maker's notch seaward; reversing it laterally mirrors the stress image.
The seaward bearings can be unloaded only below the blue tide mark and for at most seventy minutes.
After the inner float rises, the Archive service descent is one-way toward the lower wards.
Repeated vibration from iron-shod loads crazes charged saltglass; ordinary hand-tool contact does not produce that branch.
Emergency bell meaning depends jointly on strike count, measured pause, and arcade; an echo may add a heard strike without changing the sent code.
Veyru's civic year begins at the first neap tide after winter, eleven days later than the mainland year in the relevant cycle.
Upper gates must stay closed until market shutters lock and lower flow is established; opening early creates counterflow on the blue walks.
